en: The postcard features three images framed in white against a blue background. The main image at the bottom depicts a large building with a red roof, dormer windows, and a well-maintained garden, surrounded by pine trees and people walking or relaxing. The two smaller images above show other elegant villas or hotels in a lush, forested environment. The text 'BORSEC' is prominently displayed in the top right corner.
